description.en: Rhodey freezes before trying the high pool slide. He needs a calm question and a clear example before being invited to slide.
description.id: Rhodey membeku sebelum mencoba seluncuran kolam yang tinggi. Ia perlu pertanyaan yang tenang dan contoh yang jelas sebelum diajak meluncur.

completionSummary.en: Showing Rhodey the slide was safe gave him something solid to hold onto before he tried it himself.
completionSummary.id: Menunjukkan bahwa seluncuran aman memberi Rhodey pegangan yang jelas sebelum ia mencobanya sendiri.

completionTip.en: When a child freezes up from fear, give them a clear, calm reason to trust the situation before asking them to act.
completionTip.id: Saat anak membeku karena takut, beri alasan yang jelas dan tenang agar ia bisa percaya pada situasi sebelum diminta bertindak.

completedOneStar.id: Jojo dan Rhodey merasa lebih baik.

hints.en: A child's fear can ease once they have seen for themselves that something is actually safe.
hints.id: Rasa takut anak bisa berkurang setelah ia melihat sendiri bahwa sesuatu sebenarnya aman.

placementLimitMessage.en: Jojo and Rhodey are tired. You took too long.
placementLimitMessage.id: Jojo dan Rhodey kelelahan. Kamu terlalu lama.

caregiverLine.en: Now you can try sliding down.
You have to go down the slide.
Look, I will show you how safe it is.
caregiverLine.id: Lihat, aku tunjukkan dulu kalau ini aman.

caregiverLine.en: What part of the slide feels scary?
caregiverLine.id: Bagian mana dari seluncuran yang terasa menakutkan?
